item.coloph: rig sngags drag po'i gzungs sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor zhes bya ba/ slob dpon su pA gI shwa ra kIrtis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya bod gnyis la grags par gyur pa yis/ mdo sngags don la mkhas pa'i di paM ka ra la/ sgra sgyur bod na mkhas pa'i rgyal po brtson seng ges bka' bas nyams su blangs nas rin chen gser gyis zhus
